sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def st():
    f=current_frame; bs={}; pal={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['pixels']>=16 and n['color'] in 'MRNb':
            if min(rs)<50: bs[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
            else: pal[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    lines=f.ascii.splitlines()
    beam=[c for r in range(17,25) for c in range(17,47) if lines[r][c] in 'wg']
    bs['beam']=(min(beam),max(beam)) if beam else None
    return bs,pal
for a in ['LEFT','LEFT']:
    action([a])
    bs,pal=st()
    print('after',a,':',bs,'pal',pal,{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done','score')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def st():
    f=current_frame; bs={}; pal={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['pixels']>=16 and n['color'] in 'MRNb':
            if min(rs)<50: bs[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
            else: pal[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    lines=f.ascii.splitlines()
    beam=[c for r in range(17,25) for c in range(17,47) if lines[r][c] in 'wg']
    bs['beam']=(min(beam),max(beam)) if beam else None
    return bs,pal
for a in ['LEFT','LEFT']:
    action([a])
    bs,pal=st()
    print('after',a,':',bs,'pal',pal,{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('no_impact','board_changed','level_completed','done','score')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
